draft.subject: Your downgrade question, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Your question about downgrade timing is still open on our side, and support will confirm the specifics in that ticket thread rather than me guessing here. Sorry it's taken a few days.

Separately, the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits Lantern Works is one real project with a few actual tasks -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Nadia
